data.summary: Beispiel Energie AG announces a price increase for your electricity effective 1 January 2026. Your monthly advance payment rises from €72.00 to €81.00.
data.explanation: Your electricity provider is raising its prices because of higher grid fees and procurement costs. The unit price, base fee and monthly advance payment (Abschlag) all go up. You may decide to accept the increase or use your special right to cancel (Sonderkündigungsrecht) without a notice period, effective when the change takes effect. The cancellation must be in text form (Textform), for example by e-mail. The app shows until when you can cancel. If you want to switch, compare other providers first so you are not left without a supply.
